verdict.rationale: LobeHub has first-party self-hosting docs, including a dedicated Docker Compose deployment page, so a documented Docker-based self-host path exists. The pack shows only the page title, though. Nothing shows a single install command, the deployment steps, or how fast a working chat comes up. Missing for 10: a documented one-command install (script, npm/pip package, or single docker run), evidence of reaching a working chat in minutes, and hands-on or independent install reports.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes

citations.quote: LobeHub can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, giving you complete control over your data, customization, and deployment environment.
